findings.title: Stepper preflight-hold dead-ends when the blocking upload slot is hidden/cleared after the block: stale data-preflight-blocked holds Continue, messageEl scrolls into a hidden slot (absorbs r2 N11)
findings.evidence: form.js: 'if (shouldHide && !el.hidden) clearInputsWithin(el); el.hidden = shouldHide;' (no change event dispatched); clearInputsWithin sets ctl.value = "" for file inputs; evaluate() re-runs only on file-input change events (:538) and init (:546); toggleForStatusSelect hides the employer slot via 'uploadField.hidden = hidden' without clearing. form_stepper.js hold scrolls '.field-error[data-preflight-error="true"]' — inside the hidden wrapper.
findings.detail: Oversize upload sets data-preflight-blocked; applicant ticks never_rented_before (slot cleared, no event) or switches employment_status (slot hidden, file retained) — the stale block then holds Continue on the documents step and disables submit with the only error span invisible. Escape (re-show the slot, remove the file) is undiscoverable. Same root cause as r2 N11; the stepper ships default-on, making this applicant-facing.
findings.recommended_fix: Dispatch a change event (or call evaluate()) when the condition engine/employment toggle hides or clears a file input; and/or have the hold ignore messages inside hidden wrappers.
